1. Engagement Scope

Pursuant to the terms of the 1993 regulatory settlement agreement, ACPWB was engaged as an independent third-party monitor to assess Executive Compensation Research Institute's compliance with the corrective action plan. This report covers the Q1 1993 review period and evaluates progress on 47 open remediation items.

2. Methodology

The methodology for this review was aligned with the COSO Internal Control – Integrated Framework. Each of the 47 in-scope business processes was evaluated across the five COSO components: Control Environment, Risk Assessment, Control Activities, Information & Communication, and Monitoring Activities.

4. Detailed Findings
CIS-1163-001LOWOPEN
Observation

OFCCP affirmative action plan goals not updated for the current plan year

Corrective Action Required

Immediately cease all inquiries into candidate salary history during the hiring process. Update all recruiter training materials and interview guides to reflect this prohibition.

Management Response

The identified control weakness has been contained through the implementation of a temporary manual workaround. A permanent, automated control is in development with a target implementation date of Q1 1994.

Owner: Vice President of Human Resources • Due: 1993-02-28
CIS-9502-002HIGHREMEDIATED
Observation

NYSE/NASDAQ board independence requirements not met for 47 committee members

Corrective Action Required

Executive Compensation Research Institute shall conduct a full pay equity analysis across all protected class segments within 45 days of report issuance and submit a remediation plan to ACPWB for review.

Management Response

Management disputes the risk classification of this finding. While acknowledging the documentation gap, Executive Compensation Research Institute believes the underlying practices are compliant with applicable requirements. A formal response memorandum has been filed with the engagement team under separate cover.

Owner: Director of Workforce Development • Due: 1993-03-28
CIS-2286-003INFORMATIONALOPEN
Observation

Meal and rest break premiums not paid for 47 non-exempt employees with missed breaks in 4

Corrective Action Required

Automate the COBRA notification process to ensure qualifying event notices are generated and mailed within 5 business days of the triggering event.

Management Response

Management agrees with the finding. The issue has been added to the agenda for the next quarterly business review with the responsible process owners to ensure accountability.

Owner: Chief Strategy Officer • Due: 1993-02-28
CIS-8357-004LOWOPEN
Observation

Final pay for 47 terminated employees in California not provided within the statutory timeframe

Corrective Action Required

The deferred compensation plan committee will conduct a full review of all plan operations to ensure strict compliance with the documentary and operational requirements of IRC §409A.

Management Response

The finding is valid and has been added to our compliance remediation backlog. It has been prioritized for action in the next fiscal quarter, subject to resource availability.

Owner: Operations Coordinator • Due: 1993-04-28
